The Cross River State Police Command has arrested four suspected armed robbers in connection with two reported cases of motorcycle snatching in Akamkpa Local Government Area of the state. The suspects were identified as Oyo Effiong Nakanda, 40; Udeme Bright Felix, 23; Saviour Victor Felicia, 18; and Moses Ernest Felicia, 17. In a statement issued in Calabar on Wednesday by the state Police Public Relations Officer, ASP Sunday Eitokpah, the police said the arrest followed a credible tip-off from a member of the public. He said the tip-off led to an intelligence-led operation at about 5:47 a.m. on Wednesday, 18 November 2026. The statement read, “The Cross River State Police Command has arrested four suspected armed robbers identified as Oyo Effiong Nakanda, male, 40; Udeme Bright Felix, male, 23; Saviour Victor Felicia, male, 18; and Moses Ernest Felicia, male, 17, in connection with two reported cases of motorcycle snatching in Akamkpa Local Government Area. The information identified a suspected hideout along the Calabar–Ikom Highway, before Ekomita Junction.” The police spokesman said operatives of the Violent Crime Response Unit, Sector 2, Akamkpa, mobilised to the location and arrested the suspects. A machete and suspected criminal charms were recovered during the operation. “The suspects are currently being investigated in connection with two separate incidents of motorcycle snatching reported at Hitech Junction and Usang Road, Akamkpa LGA,” the statement read. The Commissioner of Police in the state, CP Ajo Ordue, commended the operatives for their prompt response and acknowledged the contribution of the informant. He reaffirmed the Command’s commitment to intelligence-led policing and urged residents to sustain collaboration with the Police by providing credible and timely information. He assured the public that the investigation would be pursued professionally and encouraged residents to report suspicious activities or emergencies through the Command’s Control Room numbers: 0704 177 7060 and 0705 335 5415. “I commend the operatives for their prompt response. I hereby urge residents to sustain collaboration with the Police by providing credible and timely information to us. Ensure you report suspicious activities or emergencies through the Command’s Control Room numbers: 0704 177 7060 and 0705 335 5415,” he added. The arrests come amid continued police action against motorcycle theft and robbery in the state. Earlier this month, the Command busted a cross-border syndicate that allegedly stole motorcycles and tricycles in Akwa Ibom and sold them in Cross River. In April, police in Calabar arrested a 26-year-old man who allegedly attacked a motorcyclist with a machete and fled with his motorcycle and phone. The Calabar–Ikom Highway, where the suspects were found, has also featured in earlier arrests over alleged robberies of travellers. Emem Julius
